ITEM 1 | Pale green torn leaves with ruffled edges and pale yellow-white center ribs, lightly glossy with creamy coating, forming a loose mound about 9 cm across and 2.5 cm tall, covering roughly 25% of the plate, sitting on the white plate with scattered shards nearby | 120
ITEM 2 | Thin, flat, off-white to pale yellow shavings with slightly curled edges and a dry, slightly grainy surface, scattered over and within the leafy mound, about 0.3 cm thick and 1 to 2 cm long pieces | 12
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown toasted bread cubes with crisp, slightly rough surfaces and pale interiors, roughly 1.5 cm square, four visible pieces, one with darker browned edge, lying around the leaves on the plate | 20
ITEM 4 | Creamy pale coating with slight sheen binding the leaves, visible as a light, semi-opaque glaze on the greens and clinging to leaf surfaces, thin layer covering about 10% of the leafy mound | 10
ITEM 5 | Small loose leaf fragments, bright green with lighter edges, scattered at the plate rim, each about 1 to 2 cm, matte and slightly limp | 5
